name: President Donald J. Trump International Airport (formerly Palm Beach International)

runway.v: the largest runway is 10,000 ft × 150 ft (about 3,048 m × 46 m); runways shown are 10L-28R, 10R-28L and 14-32

customs.v: CBP clears aircraft 7 days a week 09:00–19:00 (office hours 08:00–20:00 Eastern Time); contact CBP at least 4 hours before leaving the foreign port; FIS facility on its own ramp, not attached to an FBO or the terminal

hours.quote: The airport has a 24-hour control tower and a U.S. Customs & Border Protection port of entry facility.

handling.v: three full-service FBOs (not named on the page); general aviation uses the south side of the field and may not use the north ramps without the Department's approval
handling.quote: three full service fixed base operators

notes: Operator is the Palm Beach County Department of Airports; its site now names the airport 'President Donald J. Trump International Airport' (DJT); CBP's fact sheet (7 Mar 2024) uses KPBI. The voluntary night restraint could not be verified: pbia.org/noise redirects to https://flydjt.org/noise/ and that page, and https://discover.pbc.gov/airports/pages/noise-abatement.aspx, were blocked; the two Part 150 documents opened were for Lantana (LNA), not this airport. The CBP sheet gives no time zone on the 0900-1900 line; Eastern Time is given for office hours. KPBI is not in the US AIP AD 2 Florida page. ft to m conversion mine (1 ft = 0.3048 m).
